{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute average revenue per completed order
avg_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Confirm: no QA orders in completed set
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

print(f'Average revenue per completed order: {avg_revenue}')"}
